changes: Bind the main native window; identify dynamic capture windows and retain the original packaged trustedSender and IPC handler.
Permit only exact auxiliary state, boolean occupancy and empty hide calls from trusted capture windows. Keep task acceptance exclusive to the specified task in the trusted main window.
Record received/rejected/exception origin, window role, bounded title, profile and handler boundary without payload text; non-page URL bodies are replaced by protocol/hash.
Check root and phase STOP files at the original-handler boundary; expired or stopped acceptance is refused before mutation.
Recognize only the exact original shutdown response for trusted reads after an observed before-quit event. Preserve the original returned error/hash; all other failures still stop.
Open the exact F04 task and verify the visible main window and enabled acceptance button before requesting human action.
Provide a separate single-use 45-minute F04-only session with zero model budget and no G01/business/real-CLI entry.

reviewCorrections.resolution: Require observed shutdown, later trusted read, strict single-field original error; negative tests cover running errors, extra fields and mutations.
